messages:
incident-bot: ALERT - 95th token latency elevated for text-gen in us-west-2. Observed start: 2024-11-02T03:12:00Z.

sam: I'm taking this. Scope?

incident-bot: Models: rwd-ggml-13b, rwd-std-7b. 95th token latency ~1.8s; error rates normal; spike began ~03:12 UTC.

sam: tagging runtime + infra - @carla @raj. Carla, check batcher metrics. Raj look at GPU queue depth and autoscaler.

carla: continuous-batcher logs show batch wait windows long; median batch size went from 6 -> 34 on ggml pool. KV cache evictions up. Looks like bursty lightweight requests are coalescing.

raj: GPU utilization ~92% on pool hosted-west-2-gpu-a. Queue depth elevated. Autoscaler didn't add nodes due to reserved capacity guardrails.

sam: immediate opts: (A) reduce continuous_batcher.max_wait_ms to favor latency, (B) enable tenant isolation to prevent cross-tenant HOL, (C) soft-rate limits on free tier, (D) disable streaming for noisy endpoints. Which do we flip quickly?

carla: (A)+(B) first. I'll lower max_wait_ms 80->20ms for impacted models and cap max_batch_size to avoid giant batches. Prepare rollback.

carla: runtime change command:
```
redwoodctl runtime set-config --pool hosted-west-2-gpu-a --model rwd-ggml-13b \
  --config '{"continuous_batcher.max_wait_ms": 20, "continuous_batcher.max_batch_size": 48}'
```

deploy-bot: cfg deploy started (cfg-2162509999-1) by carla

deploy-bot: cfg deploy succeeded (cfg-2162509999-1)

carla: change is live. Watching 95th.

sam: report numbers after 5m.

carla: 5m post-change: 95th down 1.8s -> 720ms. Median stable. Batch size avg ~9. Throughput drop ~18% for pool.

amy: CS note: two paying customers flagged issues. I'll prep comms. If we throttle free-tier, we should notify.

sam: next enable tenant isolation at routing layer.

raj: enabling tenant isolation flag now.
```
redwoodctl infra set-routing --pool hosted-west-2-gpu-a --set tenant_isolation=true
```

deploy-bot: infra change started (infra-2162509999-2)

deploy-bot: infra change completed (infra-2162509999-2)

raj: tenant isolation active. Cross-tenant coalescing stopped.

carla: observing paying tenants: 95th ~550ms. Overall pool 95th ~700ms. Throughput down more but paying preserved.

sam: amy, confirm any remaining impacted customers.

amy: pixl.ai reports improvement but sees 2% token stalls. They're OK with reduced throughput if latency is steady.

sam: we'll apply soft rate-limits on free tier to damp bursts.

raj: adding rule now:
```
redwoodctl rate-limit add --pool hosted-west-2-gpu-a --match \"tier==free\" --rps 20 --burst 40 --duration 30m --reason \"mitigate tail latency\"
```

deploy-bot: rate-limit rule added (rl-2162509999-3)

raj: rule active. Early telemetry shows fewer spikes from anon keys.

carla: combined mitigations stable. Paying tenant 95th ~520-600ms; overall ~700ms. Throughput down ~25% for pool.

sam: I'll open INC ticket and add action items: revert steps once autoscaler/capacity or tuned batch profiles in place. Also adjust autoscaler thresholds for sudden short bursts.

sam: INC-2456 created: summary + mitigation + business impact.

hemang: SRE note: watch for oscillations when autoscaler fires or when we roll back max_wait_ms. Capture request traces for perf lab repro.

carla: I'll run fed-replay using request histogram tomorrow and propose per-model max_wait_ms tuning rather than global.

amy: I'll send customer update with timeline for follow-up.

sam: handing to morning rotation: @raj + @carla. My oncall ends in 20m. Leave the mitigation until we have autoscaler changes.

raj: taking ownership. Will maintain rules and open autoscaler tweak ticket; coordinate with capacity planning.

sam: thanks everyone. If latency rises reapply tenant isolation or disable streaming for free tier. Rollback snippets below.

carla: rollback commands:
```
redwoodctl runtime set-config --pool hosted-west-2-gpu-a --model rwd-ggml-13b \
  --config '{\"continuous_batcher.max_wait_ms\": 80}'
redwoodctl rate-limit remove --id rl-2162509999-3
redwoodctl infra set-routing --pool hosted-west-2-gpu-a --set tenant_isolation=false
```

deploy-bot: note: all changes logged under INC-2456.

raj: confirmed handoff. I'll post final summary in #incidents and link runbook.

sam: signing off. great job. :thumbsup:
